# Context callback result

An owned private instance method binds one Object method formal through one
complete invariant private static callback slot and its direct formal result.
The known nominal context and exact primitive inputs supply no formal binding.
Its returned object is the actual callback result, including replacement and
null values; no callback execution or result is predicted by the type proof.

Fresh JVMs check receiver, context and callback identity, all scalar inputs,
virtual callback dispatch, result snapshots, ignored returns, delayed caller
casts, nulls and original failure identity. Public and package owner profiles
compare every original definition and compiler fact, without projections.
Wrong programs must fail the frozen observer before recovery; only owned code
is executed.
